title: remanence
author: diid
facts: convolutional image decoder (4 conv layers, two output heads)
1,512 conv weights (int16) plus 110,592 stored latent values
data contracts (SSTORE2) — weights, activation tables, and 16 painting latents
one 192×144 indexed-color BMP, computed inside the EVM
description: remanence stores sixteen paintings on Ethereum as compressed fragments. A small neural decoder turns fragments back into a picture. The decoder weights and the fragments are in data contracts. The model runs inside Ethereum: one read-only call runs every layer and returns a finished image. Collectors combine fragments to restore a painting, or mix paintings into a chimera.

call.note: tokenURI(tokenId) — runs the decoder on the selected token’s fragments and returns its image as token metadata.

input.label: TOKEN ID
input.hint: Enter an existing token ID. Burned tokens and IDs that have not been minted cannot return an image.

preview.note: Ethereum computes this image from the selected token’s fragments. If its owner burns the token, this call stops working.
